critical_code_review_comments: orders.py POST /api/orders correctly re-prices from Mongo service_catalog / Supabase freezone_packages and ignores any price_aed / final_total sent by the client — verified: forged single-service order with price_aed=1 stored as 1000.
orders.py get_order strips MongoDB _id from the response - good.

services_catalog.py DELETE is a soft-delete (sets is_active=false). This is fine but should be documented; it does mean GET /api/admin/services still shows the row until Mongo doc is removed manually.
admin/app/api/[[...path]]/route.js Set-Cookie uses `Secure` — works on http://localhost in Chromium but would fail on plain-http non-localhost. Non-issue in production (HTTPS).

Next.js dev server on port 3001 keeps hitting its memory threshold and self-restarting (`Server is approaching the used memory threshold, restarting...`). Non-blocking for testing but causes ~2s recompiles that briefly break navigation. Consider bumping NODE_OPTIONS max-old-space-size.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 4 admin logins verified (founder password, manager password, staff01 PIN via /api/admin/auth/pin, reviewer01 PIN via /api/admin/auth/pin). Customer client@smartsetupuae.ae / Client@2026 verified via Supabase auth on /login and successful POST /api/orders while authenticated.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up a temporary service 'test-svc-t1' in Mongo service_catalog to verify create/patch/soft-delete/hard-delete. Test orders posted under customer_email 'TEST_orders_*@example.com' — safe to leave; snapshots collection uses UUID ids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PIN login uses /api/admin/auth/pin (not /api/admin/auth/login). Do not use `page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in', exact=True)` on /login — there are TWO elements with that text (the tab + the submit). Use form/button[type=submit] instead. On /accounting the 'Buy this service' redirect target is /login?next=/accounting when logged out. When testing admin nav, ALWAYS wait for the redirect off /admin/login using wait_for_function on pathname, because '**/admin/**' matches /admin/login too. Next.js dev server auto-restarts when memory threshold hit — retry navigation once after ~3s if you see ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found. Two 404 endpoints (/api/admin/ai-support/logs, /api/admin/email-logs/stats) are missing backend routes for two admin pages; the pages themselves render (empty state) so they don't error out.
